intent: Original artwork using reference texture and palette; no copied logos, text or UI.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one landscape 3:2 illustration for a compact starter card in an image/video creator app. Input image 1 is ONLY a texture and palette reference, not an edit target. Make an original composition inspired by its tactile hand-printed riso/crayon texture, imperfect cut-paper silhouettes, slightly misregistered overlapping inks and visible paper fibers. The screenshot includes browser/video controls: ignore ALL controls, text, logos and the white ring logo. Flat, material-rich graphic art, not a 3D render, not a vector icon. Full bleed, crisp large shapes with detailed dry pigment grain. Limited pastel palette: pale lilac, faded coral-orange, butter yellow, mint and dusty sky blue with a few charcoal ink marks. No text, letters, numbers, UI, borders, watermarks, white-ring brand symbol, gradients, glossy surfaces or stock iconography. Keep composition understandable at 260px wide.
Primary request: an abstract image-making collage. One broad dusty blue organic shape crosses a pale lilac paper field, with a cut-paper butter-yellow sun disk, soft coral curved patch, and a few mint contour marks. Balanced, spacious, playful printed-art composition; shapes cropped naturally at the edges. This is a tactile artwork, not an app screen or diagram.
